bead.title: claude-tui: ModelDiscoveryHarness live PTY snapshot with no-static-fallback enforcement
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ModelDiscoveryHarness.DefaultModelSnapshot() for claude-tui must be derived from live PTY observation of the Anthropic CLI. The no-static-fallback principle (fizeau-89eca738) forbids any Go-literal ModelSnapshot fallback in production code; on PTY failure the method must return ErrModelDiscoveryEvidenceMissing, never a baked snapshot.

ROOT CAUSE:
- Other harnesses currently embed Go-literal snapshots as a convenience; reusing that pattern in claude-tui would violate fizeau-89eca738.
- The ModelDiscoveryHarness contract requires a fresh, CLI-derived snapshot, not a constant.
- Without an AST/static check, future contributors could silently reintroduce a literal snapshot fallback.
- Cassettes under testdata/ are valid for test fixtures only; loading them from production code paths would also violate the principle.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Implement claudetui.Harness.DefaultModelSnapshot(): spawn a /model (or equivalent) PTY query against the live CLI, parse the output via internal/harnesses/anthropic helpers, return a harnesses.ModelSnapshot.
2. On PTY error, unparseable output, or empty result, return a sentinel ErrModelDiscoveryEvidenceMissing. Do not fall back to any literal.
3. Restrict cassette usage to *_test.go files; production source must not reference testdata/ paths.
4. Add a build-time or test-time static analyzer that scans the claudetui package AST for any composite literal of type ModelSnapshot (or its fields) outside *_test.go and fails the build if found.

NON-SCOPE:
- Turn execution, AccountHarness, QuotaHarness (child #2).
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 promotion (child #4).
- Changing the existing claude harness's snapshot strategy.
- Generalizing the no-static-fallback analyzer to other harnesses (scoped to claudetui in this bead).

Depends on child #1. Governing artifacts: fizeau-89eca738 (no-static-fallback principle), ADR-013, CONTRACT-004.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestClaudeTuiDefaultModelSnapshotLive asserts that, replaying a successful PTY interaction cassette in a test fixture, DefaultModelSnapshot() returns a non-empty harnesses.ModelSnapshot parsed via internal/harnesses/anthropic helpers.
2) TestClaudeTuiDefaultModelSnapshotMissingEvidence asserts that on simulated PTY failure or unparseable output, DefaultModelSnapshot() returns ErrModelDiscoveryEvidenceMissing and no partial snapshot.
3) TestClaudeTuiNoStaticSnapshotFallback runs a static AST scan over the internal/harnesses/claude-tui package (excluding *_test.go) and asserts there is no composite literal of harnesses.ModelSnapshot.
4) TestClaudeTuiNoCassetteInProductionCode asserts no non-test file under internal/harnesses/claude-tui references testdata/ paths.
5) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
6) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
